name: unlinked-pr-keeps-its-row
why: The link rule is branch AND text (section 2), and both halves are load-bearing here. PR #20's branch 'release/7-rc' matches the branch half by accident and its text mentions no ticket; PR #21 mentions #7 in prose but branches nowhere near it. Neither resolves #7, so neither folds: each keeps its own row and #7 still reads as open with no PR. A one-sided rule would swallow both into the ticket and report a ticket under way that nobody is working.

prs.title: chore: tidy the imports
prs.head: chore/imports
prs.body: Noticed while reading #7, unrelated to it.
